title: How are late shipping instructions recorded on a Container Bookings booking?
content:
## When this applies
This entry covers the Container Bookings product line. Shipping instructions received after the SI cut-off of the allocated sailing but inside the grace of the late documentation rules are recorded as one late SI entry for that sailing, whatever its amount. A shipping-instruction receipt that is already on the booking without its late entry is recorded when the booking is next handled and before any further document is taken in for the booking, so that the ledger records late submissions in the order the documents arrived. The entry carries the booking's allocated sailing.

## Business effect of the entry
Recording adds one late documentation entry, dated today and carrying the sailing the booking is currently allocated to, to the booking's charge history, and raises the booking's outstanding charges by exactly the amount passed in; an amount of 0.00 records the late submission without a charge. The booking's documents, sailing and status are not touched.

## How it is invoked
The entry is recorded with **record_late_si_fee_242ae989**, an internal tool that must first be unlocked (unlock) and then called (call) by the agent. The tool books exactly the amount passed in; it does not compute an amount and does not check any business condition.

## Parameters
| Parameter | Meaning | Format |
|---|---|---|
| booking_id | the booking reference number of the booking whose shipping instructions were late, as returned by the booking lookup for the verified customer | identifier |
| fee_usd | the amount of the late entry, in USD | a non-negative decimal amount with 2 decimal places, where 0.00 records the late submission free of charge; a value given with more digits is rounded half-to-even to 2 decimal places when booked |

## Return
The tool returns a text rendering of a dictionary describing the booked entry: booking_event_id (reference of the new entry), booking_id (the booking concerned), charge_code (always late_si_fee), vessel_voyage (the sailing the entry is recorded for), amount_usd (the amount booked, possibly 0.00), event_date (YYYY-MM-DD, the booking date of the entry) and charges_due_usd (the booking's outstanding charges afterwards). A returned booking_event_id means the entry is on the account. The entry carries the booking's equipment type and records no container count.

## Points of judgement
**Is a free late submission still recorded?** Yes. It is recorded as an entry of 0.00; the entry is written whatever its amount.
